audited_source_corrections.action: Justified eventual selection of the fixed index j by the finitely many earlier indices rather than an unsupported global decrease claim.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source says each stage leaves one fewer qualifying disjunction without restricting to the finite initial segment before j; new lower-index disjunctions can become derivable as the sets grow.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் j க்குக் கீழுள்ள முடிவுறு சுட்டெண்கள் ஒவ்வொன்றும் ஒருமுறை கையாளப்பட்ட பின் j கட்டாயம் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப்படும் என்று கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Claiming a monotone decrease in the entire infinite set of pending disjunctions.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: For a fixed j, only finitely many smaller indices can preempt it, and a handled index cannot qualify again because one disjunct has been added.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the proof establish eventual treatment of j using only finitely many possible earlier preemptions?

audited_source_corrections.action: Specified induction on the length of the extension suffix while holding the initial sequence fixed.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source says to induct on sigma although the claim extends the one-step inclusion along the suffix taking sigma to sigma-prime.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் தொடக்கத் தொடரை நிலையாக வைத்து பின்சேர்க்கையின் நீளம் மீது தொகுமுறை செய்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Induction on the initial sequence, which does not measure the number of one-step extensions.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Repeated application of Delta(sigma) subset Delta(sigma.n) is controlled by the finite suffix length.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is the induction parameter the number of extension steps?

audited_source_corrections.action: Supplied the omitted negation case by referring to its defined expansion as a conditional to falsity.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The induction contains an explicitly empty negation case between the atomic and conjunction cases.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மறுப்பு நிபந்தனைவாக்கம் மற்றும் பொருத்தமின்மையால் வரையறுக்கப்பட்ட சுருக்கம் என்பதால் அந்த இரண்டு நேர்வுகளிலிருந்து முடிவு பின்தொடர்கிறது என்று கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving a visibly blank proof case or duplicating the full conditional argument.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The syntax chapter defines negation as implication to falsity, so no independent semantic induction is required.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the negation item explain why the conditional and falsity cases cover it?
